question: Who coined the phrase 'Survival of the fittest'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Herbert Spencer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Survival of the fittest**, a term made **famous **in the **fifth edition **(published in **1869**) of **On the Origin **of **Species **by **British naturalist Charles Darwin**.
 
• It suggested **that organisms **best **adjusted **to **their environment **are the **most successful **in **surviving and reproducing**.
 
• **Herbert Spencer **(**1820–1903**) was an **English philosopher **who initiated a **philosophy called 'Social Darwinism'.**
 
• He **coined **the term **'survival of the fittest' seven years **before **Darwin's publication **of his **theory of natural history**.
 
• The **Origin **of the **Species in 1859**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Albert Einstein **was a **German-born theoretical physicist**, **widely acknowledged **to be one of **the greatest and most influential physicists **of all time. He is famous for his **Theory of Relativity**. He also **won **the **Nobel Prize in Physics**.
 
• **Archimedes **was **well known **for his **inventions **and **scientific discoveries**. The **most famous **of these were **the Archimedes' Screw **(a device for **raising water **that is still used in **crop irrigation **and **sewage treatment plants today**) and **Archimedes' principle of buoyancy**.
 
• **The theory of natural selection **was explored by **19th-century naturalist Charles Darwin**. Natural selection **explains how genetic traits **of a **species may change over time**.
